title: Composition of state renamings
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes on a Boolean input, and let $f:S\to S'$ and $g:S'\to S''$ be functions between state sets. Renaming the state of $c$ first by $f$ and then by $g$ gives the same configuration as renaming it once by the composite function $g\circ f$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with state set $S$ on input $x$
